source_quality_flag_note: All source image_quality_metrics rows have blurry_flag=1; treat this as a non-discriminating source flag, not a reason to reject all images.
split_method: Reconstructed from original metadata vineyard IDs using the prior model run summary: test Vineyard_1,8,15,22; validation Vineyard_4,11,18,25; remaining vineyards train. Counts exactly match prior summary 953/195/175 and class counts Esca 622/136/127, Healthy 331/59/48.
metadata_source: Companion repository MilindGayakwad/DNN (metadata.json, checksums.csv, image_quality_metrics.csv); source file checksums matched for all retained images.
dataset_license: Mendeley Data V5 record declares CC BY 4.0; attribute Shikalgar et al. (2026). The companion repo is used as metadata/checksum source, not as image license.
limitations: The full source images for 2,154 non-retained rows are not present locally; no pHash can be computed for those rows.
Prior per-row exclusion reason is not fully recoverable for rows without direct metadata conflict or duplicate evidence.
Source quality file flags every image as blurry; this flag is non-discriminating and must not be used as blanket exclusion.
28 vineyards appear in this curated 1,323-image subset, while the paper describes 34 vineyards in the full source.
training_status: No new training performed during this recovery audit. All 1,323 curated images were part of the prior model experiment; per-image roles reconstructed by vineyard and exact counts match.
public_location_handling: Exact farm GPS coordinates are intentionally omitted from the public manifests. The source region (Maharashtra, India), anonymized vineyard IDs, and capture-season metadata are retained.
